resolutions.change: Refresh and restoration now use one Playback-owned reconciliation rule. Durable replacement or withdrawal saves the marker and any preservation History through the existing writer without selecting a resume. Refresh awaits that write. Restart decodes the marker as a candidate, uses the journal's last local action for the phone's position, then checks the current typed resume after decoder loading before presenting the question. A stale durable marker is rejected even if a prior correction failed to save.
